doc.name: G — 30s fashion transformation set in a rooftop garden, suspenseful in tone, an ensemble crew of four, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: fashion transformation set in a rooftop garden, suspenseful in tone
Hero: an ensemble crew of four
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the fashion transformation set in a rooftop garden, suspenseful in tone form, built around an ensemble crew of four.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. Any on-screen text must use the same wording and placement logic in every act.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a crane-up that starts at knee height and finishes above eye line in Act 1 against a dolly-out that opens the frame into its environment in Act 3 — while holding the a Portra-style palette with creamy skin tones and soft greens grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second fashion transformation set in a rooftop garden, suspenseful in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same ensemble crew of four.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a jib reveal rising over a foreground object, shot on a 20mm wide at f/4, framed with a tight crop that breaks the subject at the frame edge.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with an overcast soft dome with no directional shadow at all; grade as a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, low quality, plastic skin, waxy highlights.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second fashion transformation set in a rooftop garden, suspenseful in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same ensemble crew of four.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a slow dolly-in that closes about a third of the distance, shot on a 28mm at f/2.8, framed with frame-within-frame using foreground architecture.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with blue-hour ambient with a single warm practical for separation; grade as a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, and low quality.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

config.negative_prompt: low quality, flicker, ghosting, temporal smear

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second fashion transformation set in a rooftop garden, suspenseful in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same ensemble crew of four.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a slow push with a simultaneous barely-perceptible dutch roll, shot on a 40mm anamorphic at f/5.6, framed with a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with flickering firelight as the only motivated source; grade as a punchy saturated candy palette with hard primaries. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering low quality, flicker, ghosting, temporal smear.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distortion, low quality, warped text, extra limbs
